title: TOXINIUM MOD
description: This mod give you a lot of proprieties.You can mine toxinium ore and craft the tools and armor and fight with players .
body: This mod give you a lot of effects like when you hit someone it give them a poison effect and when you have the chesplate and you do right click you get the regeneration effect.The pickaxe is op is too fast but the durability like the iron pickaxe its low. and finaly we have the other tools are very nice whit a good design.And thanks for anyone download this mod.
